name: Achiri Telegram Bridge — /achiri command wired to conversation handler
goal: Add /achiri <message> command to the Telegram bot. Any /achiri message is routed to AchiriConversationHandler with the Telegram chatId as userId (tier=free default). Bot replies with Achiri's response. This connects real users to Achiri via Telegram.
rationale: Sprint 115 shipped the HTTP API. Now we need a front-end user path. Telegram bot is already live (beta mode). Adding /achiri is the fastest route to real user conversations before the Apr 11 gate.
swarm: NOT USED — commands.ts is 302 lines (known swarm failure zone). All tasks written directly.

tasks.title: agents/telegram-bot/commands.ts — add handleAchiri()
tasks.description: Import AchiriConversationHandler. Add handleAchiri(chatId, message) that calls handler.chat(message) with tier=free. Cache one handler per chatId (module-level Map). Reply with Achiri's response. On error, reply with fallback message.

tasks.title: agents/telegram-bot/index.ts — route /achiri command
tasks.description: Add /achiri case to the switch in dispatch(). Call handleAchiri(chatId, text after /achiri). Also handle raw text (non-command) in Achiri mode if user has set /achiri_mode on.

tasks.title: scripts/achiri/validate-telegram-bridge.ts — smoke test
tasks.description: In ACHIRI_DRY_RUN=1 mode: call handleAchiri with a mock chatId and message. Verify reply is non-empty string. PASS = reply present and non-empty.
